name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump says he won't rule out sending ground troops to Iran
changes.summary: President Trump told Fox News on Tuesday that he won't rule out a ground invasion of Iran. The comments come amid another round of U.S. strikes against Iranian targets. CBS News' Eleanor Watson reports.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche to appear for confirmation hearing, U.S. restarts blockade against Iran amid standoff over the Strait of Hormuz, ICE suspends traffic stops after deadly shootings.

changes.title: For Israel, the U.S.-Iran Hostilities Have Created an Uneasy Limbo
changes.summary: Officials see a return to full-blown war as preferable to an agreement that fails to curb the threats Iran poses to Israel. Meanwhile, they wait.

changes.title: US Resumes Hormuz Blockade as Trump Threatens More Strikes
changes.summary: The United States is escalating its attacks on Iran, striking military targets including coastal defense systems and missile and drone sites. It comes as President Donald Trump in an interview warned that the U.S. will begin striking civilian infrastructure including energy targets unless Iran agrees to negotiate. NBC’.

changes.title: U.S. and Iran standoff over the Strait of Hormuz intensifies
changes.summary: threatened to block all oil exporting routes in the region on Wednesday in response to the U.S. maritime blockade of Iranian ports in the Strait of Hormuz. (Image credit: AFP via Getty Images).

changes.title: Inflation slowed sharply -- but it may not last
changes.summary: Annual inflation hit 3.5% in June, down from May's more than three-year high — but the resumption of the conflict with Iran threaten to push up inflation as energy costs once again spike. (Image credit: Brandon Bell).

changes.title: Senate Democrats Block Defense Bill Over War in Iran
changes.summary: The vote reflected how the political debate over the conflict in the Middle East has sapped bipartisan support for a normally popular measure.

changes.title: At War With Iran Again, Trump Finds an Opponent He Cannot Easily Dominate
changes.summary: The president is accustomed to forcing other countries to bend to his will. But he is struggling to come up with a strategy to extract Iranian concessions as the cease-fire he brokered collapses.

changes.title: ‘We Love Iraq,’ Trump Tells New Prime Minister in Oval Office Meeting
changes.summary: The meeting comes as President Trump’s administration has been ratcheting up pressure on Baghdad to diminish Iran’s influence in Iraq.
